purpose: A camera record format as a plug-in program beside the application (user 2026-10-23). A new format is a plug-in and one line in catalogs/record-formats/catalog.json; the application is not rebuilt. The camera itself is a text profile (catalogs/cameras).
transport: JSON lines: one JSON object per line on the plug-in's stdin (from the application) and stdout (to the application), UTF-8. stderr is not read. No line longer than 64 MiB.

about.reader_id: the reader id the camera profiles name

handshake.rule: The application refuses a plug-in that answers another contract or version, does not answer in time, or names another reader than its catalog line.

request.id: a number, one answer per request, same id

answer.ok: the operation's output, when it succeeded

body.document: IndexDocument: the index's reference and text

documents.ok: [SourceReference]: the records of the clip the application reads and gives to metadata

thumbnail.ok: SourceReference or null: the card thumbnail the index links

body.documents: [IndexDocument]: the index and the clip's records as text

metadata.ok: ClipMetadata (qnc.media.metadata): the camera's record of the clip, as the format reads it

limits: A plug-in is given texts and references only, never a path or an open file: it reads nothing else and writes nothing. It is started at its first request, serves a job and is stopped when it has had nothing to do for 30 s or when the application no longer needs it. Its answers are the format's; the camera profile and the procedure are applied by the application.
types: SourceReference, IndexDocument and GroupProposal are those of qnc-source-contract and qnc-source-groups; ClipMetadata is that of qnc-media-metadata, serialized as the application stores them.
